# Skill catalogue

Generated by `scripts/build-index.mjs` from `assets/index.json` and every skill's frontmatter. Do not edit it by hand: change the data (or a skill's description), then run `node ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/build-index.mjs --write`.

3 skills in 2 groups. Each row is the skill's own description: what Claude Code reads when it decides to load a skill.

## Contents

- Start
- Parts

## Start

Where tasks begin.

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `route-index` | Routes fixture tasks to the fixture skills. Use when a fixture needs an index. Not for alpha work (alpha-one). |

## Parts

The two parts.

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `alpha-one` | Builds the alpha part of a small test library. Use when a fixture needs a first skill. Not for the beta part (beta-two). |
| `beta-two` | Checks the beta part: a quoted description with a colon. Use when a fixture needs a second skill. Not for the alpha part (alpha-one). |
